This is a very good OET letter in many ways. There is good summary of early issues that are relevant but don’t require detail. We also good case note selection (Content), organisation (Organisation and Layout) and an appropriate style and tone (Genre and Style). 
The problem with this letter is language and grammar. I have awareded 4 for Language but this also affect clarity so I have awared 4 for Conciseness and Clarity. 
I will go throgh these:


Here the word is misspelt but also the detail is inecessary in the Introduction. 
Another issue here is using Present Perfect with ‘disontinued’: 

 Better to say ‘has not been taking since…’

This is very unclear:

I have researched what this means but you need to phrase it so it makes sense. 

Also this:



Is it not still suspected? Or is that finished now?

Overall a good letter but a few small grammar and phrasing issues take this down to a C+
